heroLede: Hands-on craft workshops and upcycled creations in Aurora, Colorado, where everyday materials become meaningful creations.
missionText: Helping children transform everyday materials into meaningful creations, while discovering the value of their ideas, talents, and voices along the way.
monthlyTheme: Each month is dedicated to a specific theme. This month is all about Birds: Bird Houses, Bird Feeders, and Bird Baths for our favorite little feathered friends.
